segments.text: Someday you'll come back here And you'll open up your arms And you'll laugh and say I knew it wouldn't take you long To realize I was gone And it's only been three years
But to me it's been so long And I remember it like yesterday Oh, you could say I've been holding on And I waited all of my life

For you to make it right But the time has come and gone And it's faded and lost all its light A star that shines so bright Falls from the sky Don't make a wish that won't come true And I learned that from you Such a long time ago
When you left you said you had to find A better way of life This one just wouldn't do And I waited all of my life For you to take your time To find your place
But I learned that this world still turns without you And you were just a phase and I learned without you here I was out for a year alone Then I have a world alone
So I've waited, I've waited I've waited, I've waited, I've waited So I've waited all of my life For you to take your time But the time has come and gone And it's fading, lost all its light
I saw this shine so bright It falls from the sky On this cold December night
